purpose: Initial RNA-seq differential-expression and QC workflow. Compares ALS progression classes using DESeq2, including a race-adjusted model and a simpler progression-only model, then produces PCA, sample-distance, lower-PC, and batch-visualization plots.
status: Mostly standalone after paths are edited.

purpose: Familial ALS transcriptomic analysis focused on C9orf72 and SOD1. Performs count filtering, VST/PCA QC, surrogate-variable analysis, model comparison, C9orf72-vs-control and SOD1-vs-control DESeq2 contrasts, convergence/divergence summaries, pathway enrichment, ALS gene-set guardrail scoring, and RNA/protein signature comparisons.
status: Large exploratory pipeline; partly standalone but should be split.

purpose: Computes Hallmark-derived metabolic, inflammation, and cell-cycle axis scores using transformed RNA-seq expression, removes mutation-confounded surrogate variables, and tests axis associations with mutation subtype, sporadic ALS, NfL, disease duration, ALSFRS-R progression, sex, and other clinical/marker covariates.
status: Mostly standalone but currently creates critical in-memory objects without saving them.

purpose: Defines transcriptomic subtypes among sporadic ALS samples from metabolic/inflammation/cell-cycle axis scores. Uses consensus clustering, assigns S-ALS subtype labels, generates heatmap/UMAP visualizations, runs pairwise subtype DESeq2 contrasts, performs pathway enrichment, evaluates NfL and ALSFRS-R progression by subtype, and runs EMT/S100B/downsampling sensitivity analyses.
status: Central downstream script; currently requires objects from the axis-scoring session.

purpose: Tests whether transcriptomic subtype and axis findings are artifacts of differentiation quality, glial contamination, proliferation, marker outliers, or related confounders. Also examines CCT2, PRS, NfL, AXIS_METABOLIC, and ALSFRS-R relationships.
status: Interactive downstream script with multiple logical analyses in one file.

purpose: Builds one-vs-rest LASSO classifiers for S-ALS-1, S-ALS-2, and S-ALS-3 using Hallmark axis genes. Runs nested cross-validation, extracts sparse gene panels, performs S-ALS-3 stability selection, and checks CCT2 subtype/NfL relationships.
status: Interactive downstream script.

purpose: Creates an IPA-ready DESeq2 result table for the S-ALS-3 vs S-ALS-2 contrast using clean SVs and sex adjustment. Also checks whether CCT2 elevation is uniform across S-ALS-3 or driven by outlier participants.
status: Interactive downstream script with explicit workspace checks.

purpose: Compares proteomics normalization strategies: log2(x+1), quantile normalization, row-wise z-score normalization, and median-centering. Produces normalized matrices and a PCA comparison PDF.
status: Standalone after paths are edited.

purpose: End-to-end proteomics differential abundance workflow. Loads corrected/imputed protein matrix, collapses technical/repeated proteomics runs to participant-level medians, builds mutation subtype metadata, normalizes abundance values, maps proteins to gene symbols, computes proteomics guardrail score, runs limma contrasts, runs Hallmark fgsea, and generates PCA/diagnostic plots.
status: Partly standalone; contains an initial exploratory block and a later end-to-end script block.

purpose: Compares C9orf72-vs-control proteomics results across pre-batch and post-batch correction strategies. Maps protein IDs to genes, collapses to gene-level values, runs limma variants with/without shipment adjustment or ComBat, compares t-statistic rank correlations, and runs Hallmark camera pathway analysis.
status: Mostly standalone but needs cleanup around metadata/count assumptions.

purpose: Runs a simple protein-level C9orf72-vs-control sensitivity analysis on pre-batch-corrected and post-batch-corrected proteomics matrices, using independent t-tests per protein, FDR correction, and overlap summaries.
status: Standalone Python script but hard-coded to one local path.

purpose: Summarizes minor allele frequency distributions from a GATK joint VCF-derived allele-frequency file. Computes MAF from AF, reports allele-number and frequency-tier summaries, and produces site-frequency spectrum plots.
status: Standalone after input file is present.

purpose: Parses ANNOVAR-style exon annotation files, creates sample-level rare damaging/LoF burden metrics, compares burden across sporadic ALS subtypes, associates LoF burden with NfL, builds gene-level burden matrices, and explores ALS-panel burden/clustering.
status: Interactive downstream script with several exploratory sections.

purpose: Builds a genotype-derived stratification model from rare damaging variants in transcriptomic-axis genes and ALS-panel genes. Constructs patient-by-gene burden matrices, builds PPI/coexpression networks, scores edge conservation/perturbation, and clusters patients using SNF.
status: Complex multi-stage workflow; should be split.

purpose: Creates PLINK/PRSet input files for pathway-level PRS testing in sporadic ALS: keep file, phenotype file containing axis scores, and covariate file containing sex. Also deduplicates longitudinal samples to the earliest transcriptomic timepoint.
status: Interactive downstream script.

purpose: Tests whether pathway-specific PRS values predict matching transcriptomic axis scores. Reads PRSet `.best` files, merges PRS with sporadic axis/subtype metadata, fits all 3 x 3 PRS-to-axis regressions, and visualizes specificity.
status: Interactive downstream script.

purpose: Tests whether common variants in the CCT2 cis-window predict CCT2 expression and checks whether top cis-eQTL variants overlap ALS GWAS association signals.
status: Interactive downstream script.

purpose: Tests whether rare damaging variant burden in subtype-defining DEG sets is enriched in the matching subtype and decomposes LoF-to-NfL associations by axis gene-set burden.
status: Interactive downstream script.

purpose: Performs targeted rare damaging/LoF variant burden tests for CCT2 and the TRiC chaperonin complex, including subtype association, S-ALS-3 membership models, and CCT2-expression association.
status: Interactive downstream script.

purpose: Tests whether rare damaging burden across HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1 could explain subtype-associated CCT2 expression variation as a trans-regulatory mechanism.
status: Interactive downstream script.
